title: After the Oka Sho: This Doesn’t Feel Right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (So this is a Triple Tiara race… Everyone here only gets this one chance to win it.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (…I guess it does feel a little special. But…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What a fantastic race! This year's battle for the Triple Tiara has finally kicked off!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You said it! I hope we get to see a bunch of elegant and spectacular races this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: The spring Classics are just getting started! Next week is the long-awaited Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: That's the race that decides who the fastest Umamusume is! There's no way I'm missing it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why is the Satsuki Sho the only race that can settle who the fastest Umamusume is?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! I'm sick of it! It just doesn't feel right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's still not ready yet! My racing magic is nowhere near complete!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, all the Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour—including Sweep Tosho—are gathered together for an interview about their future plans.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally, I intend to run in the Japanese Oaks. I hope I can count on your continued support!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Next up, we have Sweep Tosho and her trainer. Thank you for agreeing to today's interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: First, perhaps you could tell us about your future prospects and goals?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Well, there's no use talking about dumb things like prospects and goals…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because someday, I'm gonna cast my magic on each and every one of you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then everyone's lame assumptions are going out the window! When I'm done, nobody's ever gonna say "that's the way things are" again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd seems slightly shaken. I feel the weight of countless stares, and an immense pressure to step in and stop her.
choice_data_list: (…But I'm not going to stop her.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, this is Sweep Tosho's dream—her ultimate goal. And I want to respect that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I see… Your "magic," you say?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And do you mind if I ask what you were referring to when you mentioned "everyone's lame assumptions"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stuff like how Umamusume on the Triple Crown tour are supposedly stronger than Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Strong runners are strong no matter what tour they're on! Is it really such a big deal if someone from the Tiara tour beats someone from the Triple Crown? And how come it's the Satsuki Sho and not the Oka Sho that settles who's fastest?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All that stuff is lame! Laaame!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …I see. I know precisely what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Although… at the risk of sounding rude, might I ask one more question?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Speaking very frankly, the results of many races—such as the Arima Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen—support those views.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: When a runner on the Triple Crown tour and a runner on the Triple Tiara tour clash during senior-year races, for example, the latter almost always loses.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You could even say that history has proven it… What are your thoughts on that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'm just gonna go ahead and change the course of history myself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll give you my own proof! It doesn't matter what tour a runner's on—strength is strength!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: First, I'm gonna win the Triple Tiara! And then, in my senior year…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat the Triple Crown tour runners and show the whole world how tough I am!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But listen up, reporters. If any of you write some lame article about how an Umamusume from the Triple Tiara tour amazingly won or whatever, I'm gonna come for you personally.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All you need to write is, "Sweep Tosho was the strongest!" That's it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. So that's the magic you're hoping to show everyone.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter what tour an Umamusume's on—strength is strength. And you're going to prove it in your senior year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to your upcoming races. Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Otonashi seems to have grasped what Sweep Tosho was getting at, but the whole room remains astir with confusion.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Familiar, you dummy. I just did what anyone would!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "Familiar"?! Oh, what a wonderful relationship! Is that a sign of how devoted you are to her?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And I'll bet you're ready to run through fire, water, controversy, and accursed ground at her command!
choice_data_list: (That sounds like a lot of running… Hm, I wonder.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Otonashi tends to exaggerate our hardships, but as I ponder our seemingly perilous future, I can't help thinking she might be on the money this time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, Familiar! No dilly-dallying! Let's get to work!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run in that special race and complete my magic! So I need you to train me up for the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the second race of the Triple Tiara tour—the Japanese Oaks. A fierce battle to decide the Queen of the Oaks awaits our little witch!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …"Magic"? How ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: And she's already talking about her senior year… Is she trying to represent our generation or something?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Ugh… that's my role to play!
